name: agent-background-job-ledger
description: Durable background job ledger (SQLite/Postgres) that registers jobs owned by a tenant/thread/turn, runs commands, captures exit status and bounded scrubbed output, delivers completion notices at-least-once to the owning turn, replays unacknowledged notices after a crash, and reaps orphan jobs whose owner turn is gone.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js demo
